agyos_skill.instructions: A platform-neutral, model-neutral, and tool-adaptive research pipeline for autonomous research agents, coding assistants, and human scholars. Translates ambiguous research fields into defensible research questions, evidence-grounded literature corpora, falsifiable study protocols, and publication-grade synthesis reports. 1. **Direction Ownership**: The human researcher retains permanent ownership of the research direction, scientific claims, ethics compliance, data governance, and publication decisions. 2. **Provisional Recommendations**: Agent-selected topics and study plans are provisional recommendations until explicitly approved by the human researcher. 3. **Execution Guardrails**: The agent must never initiate paid API calls, execute unauthorized full-scale experiments, submit manuscripts, or access private participant data without explicit written consent. Every statement and data point must be classified into one of four explicit evidentiary classes: - `INSPECTED EVIDENCE`: Directly read and verified from primary published text, dataset files, or experimental logs. - `AGENT INFERENCE`: Logical conclusions, synthesis patterns, or interpretations derived by the agent. - `PROPOSED HYPOTHESIS`: Unverified conjectures, candidate explanations, or suggested future experiments. - `USER-REPORTED`: Background assertions, constraints, or prior results provided by the user. - A high score in impact or feasibility can never compensate for a failed novelty gate or unverified competitor baseline. - If mandatory claim conditions fail, the agent must **STOP, DROP, or NARROW** the proposal. Before initiating research, detect the host environment and select the matching execution mode: | Host Mode | Environment Characteristics | Deliverable Strategy | |---|---|---| | **Mode A: Research + Files** | Web search / scholarly APIs available; writable local file system. | Full online retrieval; generate 6 physical Markdown files in `runs/<RUN_ID>/`. | | **Mode B: Research + Chat** | Online retrieval available; no writable local file system. | Full online retrieval; output 6 clearly demarcated inline sections matching artifact names. | | **Mode C: Offline + Files** | No network retrieval; local file uploads and writable disk present. | Inspect provided documents; generate 6 physical files marked `OFFLINE / EXTERNAL VERIFICATION PENDING`. | | **Mode D: Offline + Chat** | No network retrieval; no writable local file system. | Structured analysis of user-supplied text; output 6 inline sections detailing research designs and query plans. | ``` [STAGE 1: TOPIC DISCOVERY] ────────► 01_topic_survey.md (15–20 Candidates, 11 Fields) │ ▼ [STAGE 2: EVIDENCE-GATED RANKING] ──► 02_top5_ranking.md & 03_selected_topic.md (Gates & Falsifiers) │ ▼
